build_procedure.policy_mix: first half of episodes: tests.test_ternary_world.scripted_policy with random_prob=eps (nearest waiting passenger, then its destination via the picked_up_at/request join); second half: uniform random legal actions (tests.test_ternary_world.legal_actions)
